profile.headline: Software Engineer at DIRECTV
profile.summary:
Imagine with a click of a button (or a single command), your entire workflow is automated and maintained. My goal is to transition processes and workflows into a state where it can run itself without needing to be actively upkept or managed. That way, more time can be spent focusing on creating solutions to bigger problems. 

My specialties are Java and C++, before later moving onto Python with a focus on automation. Automation is the key! I like to get things done and learn whatever I need to in order to do it. We are all in this together, and if I can make your life easier, then we both win :) 

With how quickly technology has expanded over the years, I am currently shifting to learn new technologies to better automate and manage my workflow: Serverless Computing, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS EKS, and AWS OpenSearch, just to name a few.

In my free time, I like to draw, crochet, practice yoga, and play games. I love traveling across the world and going on “eat”-cations, and hope to see more of Europe, Asia, and the rest of the world!

positions.title: Secretary
positions.description: Documented the weekly agenda and regularly updated the organization website. Researched and compiled relevant data for informative workshops and meetings. Created and managed presentations and workshops.

positions.title: Treasurer
positions.description: Reviewed all documents to ensure all organizational expenses are accurate and up-to-date. Organized and stored original, hard copy receipts in a safe environment. Recorded and maintained all financial records using spreadsheets.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed code to parse, decode, and convert satellite signals into a human viewable format in DIRECTV’s set top box. Designed and built user interface components in Java using the Google Web Toolkit (GWT) Eclipse plug-in that met Google’s Model-View-Presenter (MVP) standard. Wrote project documentation, status reports, and user manuals.

positions.title: Webmaster
positions.description: Updated and maintained organization’s website and social media and helped improve user experience by editing, organizing and presenting content that is more readable and consistent.
